name: cowart
description: A native tldraw canvas for Codex. Whenever Cowart is invoked, load the cowart_mcp MCP server and use its render_cowart_canvas_widget tool to open or refresh the native canvas before any other Cowart work.

interface.shortDescription: Load cowart_mcp and use render_cowart_canvas_widget before every Cowart workflow.
interface.longDescription: Cowart brings a tldraw-powered native widget canvas into Codex for visual planning and creative iteration. The core canvas-opening capability is the cowart_mcp MCP server and its render_cowart_canvas_widget tool. Whenever the user invokes Cowart or any Cowart skill, Codex must first load cowart_mcp and call render_cowart_canvas_widget to open or refresh the project-backed native canvas before continuing. Users can then sketch ideas, place AI image holders, generate images into selected slots, and turn annotated screenshots into revised image outputs while keeping canvas data in the user's project workspace.
defaultPrompt: Open the Cowart canvas for this project.
Use my Cowart annotation screenshot to generate a clean revised image beside the original.
Generate a new image into the selected Cowart AI image holder.
